question: Distinguish between a private company and a public company under the Companies Act, 2013.

points.label: Minimum members
points.description: A private company needs at least 2 members (one in a One Person Company); a public company needs at least 7.

points.label: Maximum members
points.description: A private company is limited to 200 members (excluding present and former employee-members); a public company has no maximum.

points.label: Transfer of shares
points.description: A private company restricts the right to transfer its shares; a public company's shares are freely transferable.

points.label: Invitation to the public
points.description: A private company cannot invite the public to subscribe for its securities; a public company can.

points.label: Minimum directors
points.description: A private company needs at least 2 directors; a public company needs at least 3.
